notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible after it enters.
You have a way to deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger after it enters.
description:
Cast Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger by paying its mana cost.
Give Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible.
Deal damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing double that much damage to itself due to Neriv.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the final Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target.
